user.title: EvMetrics
user.description: Pick the car device created by the EvMetrics app over MQTT Discovery (Settings › Devices). Normally it is discovered automatically as soon as the app connects to the broker.

confirm.title: EvMetrics
confirm.description: Add the dashboard and automation blueprints for **{name}**?

error.not_mqtt_device: This device was not created by MQTT Discovery.

abort.not_supported: This MQTT message is not an EvMetrics device.

data_description.title: Empty = the car name.
data_description.image_upload: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG up to 10 MB. Replaces the URL below.
data_description.image: For example /local/images/my-car.png. Empty = the built-in image.
data_description.live_cameras: Camera entities shown live in the Sentry section (for example the MJPEG cameras of the app).

error.invalid_image: The file must be a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image up to 10 MB.

app_outdated.title: EvMetrics app is older than this package
app_outdated.description: The car {title} runs EvMetrics {version}, but this package expects {min_version} or newer. Some cards and automations may show missing entities until the app is updated.

device_not_found.title: EvMetrics car not found
device_not_found.description: There is no MQTT device with identifier `{node_id}` (car {title}). Check that the app is connected to the broker and that MQTT Discovery is enabled, or remove and add the integration again.

dashboard_conflict.title: Dashboard address already in use
dashboard_conflict.description: A dashboard already exists at /{url_path}, so the EvMetrics dashboard for {title} was not created. Rename or delete that dashboard and reload the integration, or add the EvMetrics dashboard yourself under Settings › Dashboards › Add dashboard.

dashboard_unsupported.title: Dashboard could not be registered
dashboard_unsupported.description: This Home Assistant version did not accept the EvMetrics dashboard for {title}. Add it yourself under Settings › Dashboards › Add dashboard › EvMetrics.
